entities.name: Query GlmU-like protein
observations: Sequence length is 461 aa and contains several ambiguous X residues, preventing reliable physicochemical calculations.
Best curated homologs are bacterial bifunctional GlmU proteins with 51.2–52.2% identity, 98.0–98.5% query coverage, and E-values of 1.5e-161 to 2.2e-158.
Likely catalyzes the final two steps of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis: glucosamine-1-phosphate acetylation and UDP-GlcNAc formation.
Likely binds one Mg2+ per subunit, is cytoplasmic, and forms a homotrimer, based on conserved homolog annotations.
Pfam supports an N-terminal nucleotide-transferase region (NTP_transf_3 and NTP_transferase; residues 7–213) and C-terminal GMPPB_C/hexapeptide-repeat-associated regions.
Functional assignment is moderate homology support rather than direct experimental characterization of this exact sequence.

entities.name: Bacterial GlmU
observations: Bifunctional enzyme family that catalyzes glucosamine-1-phosphate N-acetyltransferase and UDP-N-acetylglucosamine diphosphorylase activities.
Typical pathway product is UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine, a precursor for peptidoglycan and, in Gram-negative bacteria, lipid A/LPS biosynthesis.

entities.name: GlmU acetyltransferase reaction
observations: alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + CoA + H(+). Rhea RHEA:13725; associated EC 2.3.1.157 in curated homologs.

entities.name: GlmU UDP-GlcNAc synthesis reaction
observations: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP + H(+) = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + diphosphate. Rhea RHEA:13509; associated EC 2.7.7.23 in curated homologs.

entities.name: GlmU Mg2+ binding
observations: Curated GlmU homologs are annotated to bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit; this is inferred for the query from strong homology, not directly measured.
